summary: Concise, well‑documented confirmatory paired study comparing a generate→verify→repair (G→V→R) pipeline to an LLM‑only suggestion pipeline on a deterministic synthetic NetOps task pool. Execution and analysis artifacts are extensive and appear internally consistent. The observed outcome is a degenerate null: baseline and guarded arms each produced 200/200 validator‑compliant applies (n11=200; no discordant pairs), so the preregistered primary estimand is exactly zero with an exact McNemar p=1.00 and a degenerate 95% bootstrap CI [0.00,0.00]. The manuscript responsibly reports ceiling effects and major limitations (single model, synthetic tasks, validator dependence) and includes the mandatory disclosure and extensive provenance/hashes.
required_revisions: Add a short, explicit aggregated summary (table or single sentence) reporting the number of episodes where the repair loop was invoked and/or repair_applied=true across all 200 pairs (artifact evidence exists in validator traces; this should show zero).

Explicitly state in Results that the shared_initial_generation design produced identical initial candidates across conditions (as preregistered) and therefore the guarded arm could act only via the repair pathway; clarify that no repairs occurred, and interpret the null result accordingly (to avoid misreading the null as evidence that verification cannot help when generation differs).

In Results or Threats to Validity, add a concise paragraph clarifying the statistical degeneracy consequences: when n10=n01=0 the paired estimate and bootstrap CI are degenerate and secondary estimands (time‑to‑deploy, model‑calls‑per‑success) are uninformative; link these statements to the archived analysis artifacts (analysis/*) so readers can reproduce the degeneracy.
optional_revisions: In Related Work provide exact citations (DOI/arXiv/primary source) for the closest verifier‑assisted NetOps papers referenced; a short evidence table mapping each cited work to the specific claim in Related Work would strengthen positioning (artifacts contain verified record ids).

Add a brief per‑task example (1–2 lines) in main text showing a representative validator_trace where repair_applied=false to illustrate how the validator records were used (the manuscript already archives several representative task files).

Mention explicitly that model_calls_used=200 arises from shared_initial_generation only (no additional generation or repair model calls occurred), and point to execution/model_configuration.json and provider call artifacts for verification.
